summary: the same commit id is used more than once
help: Give each commit a distinct id value.
rationale: Merge and cherry-pick statements reference commit ids, so a duplicate makes those references ambiguous.

summary: the same tag value is used on more than one commit
help: Give each tag a distinct value, or remove the duplicate.
rationale: Two commits render with the same tag, so the tag cannot identify one commit.
